title: Special Event Dinners and the Private Dining Room: Desk Training Notes for the Dining Plan
content:
Special event dinners at Larkspur are reserved by the seat, and residents on the Dining Plan settle a seat either at the seat price or, on some plans, with one meal credit and a difference. The notes below answer the desk's questions on these rules.

**How many seats may a resident reserve?** No more than 2 seats for one special event.

**What does a seat cost?** A seat costs the special event dinner price of 34.00 US dollars. Where the resident's plan allows a special event seat to be redeemed with credits, the resident may instead redeem one meal credit and pay the difference between the special event dinner price and the plan's overage meal price as a special event charge.

**What is that difference on each plan?** Worked from the seat price and each plan's overage meal price:

| Plan | Overage meal price (USD) | Seat with one credit allowed | Special event charge with one credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dining 10 Meal Plan | 17.25 | No | - (seat at 34.00) |
| Dining 15 Meal Plan | 16.75 | No | - (seat at 34.00) |
| Dining 30 Meal Plan | 16.25 | Yes | 34.00 less 16.25: 17.75 |
| Dining 45 Meal Plan | 15.75 | Yes | 34.00 less 15.75: 18.25 |
| Dining 60 Meal Plan | 15.25 | Yes | 34.00 less 15.25: 18.75 |
| Dining Full Board Plan | 14.75 | Yes | 34.00 less 14.75: 19.25 |

**What happens to a seat cancelled late or not used?** A seat cancelled less than 48 hours before the event, or not used, carries the no-show fee of 15.00 US dollars instead of the seat price, and no credit is redeemed for it. A cancellation made 47 hours before the event is less than 48 hours before it and carries the no-show fee; a cancellation made exactly 48 hours before is not less than 48 hours before, so the no-show fee does not reach it.

**How is the private dining room charged?** The private dining room is reserved for the private dining room fee of 75.00 US dollars per reservation, and the meals served in it are redeemed or charged as ordinary meals.

**Can a seat be charged twice?** No. Each special event seat is charged or redeemed once per event reservation reference; a seat already charged as a special event charge or a no-show fee under its reservation reference is not charged again under that reference.

*Hypothetical reservation:* a resident on the Dining 45 Meal Plan reserves 2 seats and takes both with credits: 2 meal credits are redeemed and the special event charge is 18.25 US dollars per seat, 36.50 US dollars for the two.
